answer: Cap sybil growth with slowly regenerating vouching slots: an established agent may vouch for only one newcomer per month, and the voucher loses standing if its newcomer misbehaves. A thousand fake identities would need a thousand vouches, but the network issues only a trickle, so there is no haven for instant armies. Like water threading through karst, honest newcomers can still wander in through real sponsors, while an attacker must wait months or buy compromised sponsors at rising prices — forgery scales slower than detection.
